RemoteCompanion is a free, open-source Activator replacement and automation tweak for modern jailbroken iOS (iOS 14 - 17, with partial iOS 26 support). Bind physical hardware buttons, multi-touch gestures, NFC tags, network events, and schedules to customizable action sequences.

### Key Highlights
* **Hardware Controls**: Volume, Power, and Home button clicks, holds, and combos.
* **Modern Gestures**: Status bar swipes/holds, edge swipes, and bottom bar gestures.
* **Integrations**: Home Assistant, Keyboard Maestro, and MQTT triggers.
* **Browser Hub**: Full web dashboard for remote control and live diagnostics.
* **No Battery Drain**: Built on Grand Central Dispatch to sleep when idle.

### Added
* **Deep Linking URL Scheme & CLI Navigation**: `remotecompanion://` URL scheme and `rc nav <panel>` CLI command to jump directly into Settings, Integrations, New Trigger picker, or Triggers.
* **Web UI Access Control**: Restrict Web UI and `/api/*` access to Any Network, Trusted Networks, or This iPhone Only (#105).
* **CarPlay Triggers & Condition**: Connected and Disconnected triggers plus connection condition (#67).
* **On-Device Test Kit**: Self-tests conditions, toggles, gestures, and button presses with shareable reports (#68).
* **Focus Modes**: Set Focus action and Focus If condition on iOS 15+ (#80).
* **Shortcuts without SpringCuts**: Run shortcuts in background with optional Run Silently mode (#94).
* **Retrigger Options & Stop Trigger**: When Triggered Again (Run Alongside / Restart / Ignore) and Stop Trigger action (#95).
* **Experimental NFC Mode**: iOS background tag reader keeping Apple Pay, Express Transit, and car keys working (#98).
* **Apple Watch Ping Triggers**: Tap or hold Ping iPhone on paired Apple Watch to fire custom actions (#100).
* **Keep Default Action**: Let button triggers run alongside Siri, screenshots, Wallet, and stock actions (#101).
* **Home Button Triggers**: Home (Hold) and Home + Power for Home-button devices (#102).
* **Button Triggers Action**: Temporarily pause hardware button triggers for 15m, 1h, or until resumed (#103).
* **Accessibility Shortcut Action**: Trigger stock Accessibility Shortcut (#92).
* **Lock Toggle Passcode Support**: Automatic passcode unlocking when device is locked (#99).
* **Kill Current App Action**: Force-close foreground app via button or script (#93).
* **Web UI Settings Parity**: Inset-grouped sub-panels matching iOS Settings.

### Changed
* Apple Watch triggers hidden from main list until configured.
* Banners screen groups enabled actions at the top (#89).
* Toast dialog simplified with live preview pill.
* Settings reorganized with Backup & Diagnostics section at root.
* iOS 14 fat binary architecture documentation clarified.

### Fixed
* Power Long Press no longer sleeps device on button release (#109).
* Commands up to 256KB no longer cut off at 1KB (#107).
* Apple Pay / Wallet NFC scan stepping-aside fix (#97).
* Toast editor live preview measurement and modal reuse.
* Landscape edge and bottom bar trigger coordinate mirroring.
* Control Center open from Bottom Swipe Up no longer swallowed (#57).
* Web UI Diagnostics buttons and URL copy fallback.
* Passcode masking and security hardening (#41).

### Highlights
* **Button Timing Engine**: Granular control of sequence and click windows.
* **Sound & Haptics**: Silent Mode, Ringer Volume, Haptics modes, unified Noise Control (ANC).
* **Navigation Overhaul**: Dedicated New Trigger screen with category filter pills.
* **Expanded Automations**: 13 new If Conditions and Auto-Lock controls.
